case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Attributable human/group responsibility and traceable disclosure of relevant AI assistance. Access differences become critical where a required tool blocks participation without a workable alternative.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: While N087 (2.1, 6.3.1) requires collective honesty in groupwork and authorisation for AI-produced work, Murdoch policies lack an operational mechanism for attributable human/group responsibility and traceable disclosure of individual AI assistance across group members.
case_summary.case_note: Murdoch's Student Academic Integrity Policy (N087) requires collective honesty in groupwork (2.1) and prohibits submitting AI-produced work without assessment authorisation (6.3.1), while N112 defers unit-level GenAI expectations to Unit Outlines. No operative policy requires group-level tracking or traceable disclosure of individual AI assistance or addresses unequal AI tool access, leaving a critical gap. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15, and this proposal awaits human verification.
